statuses.observed_timeout: harness actually hit its timeout during a run
statuses.observed_error: run finished with an error (engine limit, throw, password); not a timeout
statuses.operator_aborted: process killed by the operator / OOM / manually before the cell finished
statuses.not_run: never started, including cells skipped because a timeout was predicted

note: Raw evidence files are never edited. Files marked tracked:false live under gitignored perf/results or outside the repo; their sha256 is recorded so later edits are detectable.
